title: Writhen Skies, Rejacketed Future
summary: In a crashed mart, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, examines a kymograph. Turbid skies hang over writhen metal and jetsam. Amidst the samey checkers, a savage tiger's shadow stretches long. They keenly observe the pellmell rush of trafficked junkies, the whisper of kavakavas a pejorative echo. Opposing the elites who fly airplanes, jacked on legerdemain, they prepare for confrontation. An unprovoked vendor of an outlandish autojumble, a ninja-like figure with bloodlines of a king, is gaffed by ruthless gamekeepers and held captive in a manhole. Rushing effluent creates a wudjula-like mist. The landscape is now junked, its chalky ground etched with inklike inkblots. Flashbacks of other lockups fade as they find a merry sense of accomplishment, rejacketing the future with just enough incentives.
